protocol_changes.lock: Each REAL block (<= 10 trials) runs as one <lanes>/bin/quiet-timed phase (EXCLUSIVE quiet-lane lock, receipt line with label own75r-<block> in the shared quiet-lane ledger) through the new harness/run_batch_qt.sh, instead of run_batch.sh's 'flock -s' (a nested shared flock on the same lock file inside quiet-timed would deadlock). run_batch.sh stays in the tree unchanged and is not used. The packet keeps its own receipts in raw/real/lock-ledger.jsonl (acquired + released per block, mode exclusive) and an excerpt of the shared-ledger lines for its labels in raw/real/quiet-lane-ledger-excerpt.jsonl. The lock is released between blocks (chunks of about 1-2 minutes, far under 15 minutes) so higher-priority lanes (R2-10) can take it.
